gloss: to move out of the way; to push aside

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: どけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to move something out of the way; to push aside; to clear away
definitions.explanation: To move an object or obstacle from a place so that the space is free. A common everyday transitive verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please move your luggage out of the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧な⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どけた。
examples.english: I moved the box that was in the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どけて、⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I cleared the things off the table and made a wide workspace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通路|つうろ}→通路：04062_tsuuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どけて⟦もらえません→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you move the bicycle that's blocking the pathway?

notes:
A very common everyday verb for moving things out of the way. Written in hiragana in most contexts, though the kanji ⟦{退|ど}ける→退く：02377_doku⟧ or {除|ど}ける exists. Typically used for clearing physical obstacles or clutter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どける: to move luggage out of the way
- ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧な⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どける: to clear away obstructions
- ⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧どける: to move to the side
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どける: to move one's body out of the way

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive counterpart is どく (to get out of the way, to step aside). Example: どいて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (Please move out of the way).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どく: to get out of the way (intransitive counterpart)
- ⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to tidy up, to put away (implies organizing, not just clearing)
- {退|ど}かす: to move aside (variant form, same meaning)
